title: A kitchen garden behind the house
description: Against the rear fence, the garden opens a gate and adds planted food beds along the shared boundary.

title: A driveway meets the front road
description: A road beside the front garage slot opens the drive. A road against the rear fence leaves it closed.

title: A continuous townhouse row
description: Both buildings face the same street. Side walls meet across the shared edge, with separate entrances along the front.

title: An ATM facing the bank
description: The cashpoint opens toward its neighbor. Paving and lamps mark the shared commercial frontage.

title: One farmhouse, five fields
description: Five separate field plots open onto the farmhouse. Their tilled edges continue across former boundaries, and each shared edge contributes to the farm bonus.

title: A gate between church and graveyard
description: The cemetery opens onto the church grounds. The gate and shared path add recreation while protecting the buildings and headstones.

title: A platform beside the main line
description: The station faces away from the continuous track. Its yellow boarding edge meets the rails along the back of the platform.

title: A shelter on the curb
description: The shelter leaves the carriageway free. A curb alone needs a depot and a route to carry passengers.

title: Taxi dispatch beside a through street
description: The covered waiting area opens toward the yellow pickup curb; the road continues on either side.

title: A ferry landing and its berth
description: Boats need a clear approach with enough water for their draft. A reachable landing at the other end completes the passenger route.
